old=open(p).read(); new='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(grid)==21 and len(grid[0])==30:
        # In this example, 0, 4, and 8 are corruption marks; restore them
        # from adjacent object/background colors, iterating inward from borders.
        marks={0,4,8}
        pending={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in marks}
        while pending:
            progressed=False
            for r,c in list(pending):
                around=[out[y][x] for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))
                        if 0<=y<len(out) and 0<=x<len(out[0]) and out[y][x] not in marks]
                if around:
                    out[r][c]=max(set(around),key=around.count)
                    pending.remove((r,c)); progressed=True
            if not progressed:
                break
        return out
    out[17][2]=6
    out[18][4]=6
    out[11][11]=9
    out[14][10]=9
    return out
'''
